ga-11-rejected-output.reason: A model output the schema rejects fails VALIDATION_FAILED with no server part: since D-081 removed the credit line (the only part such a failure had), the app draws the failure card from the task's errorCode (assistant_screens `_taskFailure`, CH25), so the person is never left without a reply. The invariant predates that; kept as a baseline, not a bug (lumi-plan §13 L10).
